cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The tent falling is our planned turning point. Remember the loose peg I mentioned?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then nobody would understand why it mattered later.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the earlier remark about waterproof coats has become remarkably well placed.

mechanism: Copy a camper's peg removal without knowing it is a spare, then reinterpret an earlier stars remark as setup for the collapsed tent's planned outdoor turn.
confusable: Not random optimism about wet camping: an actual early remark must become A's claimed preparation for the specific failure.
comparison: Camp shelter and a tarp offer rather than cake served in bowls.
seedUse: Retains tent/loose peg/planned turn structure; makes the stars remark explicit instead of introducing waterproof-coat foreshadowing only at A5.
